description: Starts at high load (50 users for 60s) then steps down through 25 users (60s) to 5 users (60s). Evaluates scale-down cooldown enforcement (120s) and rollout protection.

stages.name: High Load Tier
stages.description: High load to establish scaling state

stages.name: Intermediate Tier
stages.description: Reduced load tier triggering cooldown tracking

expected_observations: Orderly pressure reduction across all services
Scale-down decisions strictly held until scale_down_window_sec (120s) expires
Deployment-phase guardrails prevent scale-down if phase is ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT
Replica recommendations decrement safely by at most max_replica_change (2)
Replica floor at 1 is strictly observed
